note: untrained execution-speed diagnostic -- decode tok/s and memory only, not a quality claim. Scaled version of results/local/hz0h_static_kv_transformer_decode_benchmark.json to ~0.8B params to match Qwen3.5-0.8B's scale (results/local/hz0h_qwen35_decode_benchmark.json), per explicit user request. NOT directly comparable in absolute tok/s to the 300M run -- that ran on RTX 4090, this ran on RTX 5090 (different hardware). The BDH-vs-Transformer RATIO within THIS run is a fair, same-GPU comparison. Qwen3.5-0.8B was benchmarked on RTX 4090, not 5090 -- a true same-GPU 3-way comparison at 0.8B scale does not yet exist.
result_recovery_note: The benchmark script's own JSON write only happens once after the full context sweep; this run crashed with a genuine CUDA OOM at context=131072 (tried to allocate 2.00 GiB with only 1.55 GiB free of 31.36 GiB total -- a real VRAM ceiling on the 5090 with a much bigger model, not a bug) before reaching that write. The four completed context points below were captured directly from the run's stdout log, not from the script's own (never-written) output file.

131072.detail: torch.OutOfMemoryError during Transformer FFN gate projection: tried to allocate 2.00 GiB, 1.55 GiB free of 31.36 GiB total. Genuine VRAM ceiling on RTX 5090 with the larger 0.8B model resident, not a code bug.

headline_finding: At ~0.8B params, the BDH-vs-Transformer decode crossover is far more decisive than at 300M: BDH is flat at 44.2 tok/s across all contexts, while the fair Transformer's decode collapses from 308.7 (context=128) to 23.6 tok/s (context=65536) as its 5 real attention layers pay increasing quadratic cost. At context=65536, BDH is 1.873x faster than the Transformer -- vs. only a 1.03x near-tie at the same context in the 300M-param comparison. The crossover point itself also appears to arrive earlier relative to context as parameter count grows (BDH already leads decisively by 16384-65536 rather than only right at the edge), consistent with the hypothesis that BDH's O(1)-state advantage compounds with scale while Transformer attention cost does not.
